prompt: The RLS key builder uses cmp.Equal for comparing builder maps. This panics on certain types when the LB policy receives a service config update. Find and fix the unsafe equality comparison in the RLS key builder.
The GCP environment detection code panics when the DMI product name file is not present. The code assumes the file always exists and does not handle its absence gracefully. Fix the panic.
The DNS resolver performs resolution requests without any rate limiting, which can cause excessive lookups under certain conditions. Add rate limiting to the DNS resolution logic.

When a command searches its args to find the arg matching a subcommand name, flag values are not skipped. This means a flag value that happens to match a subcommand name will be incorrectly treated as the subcommand invocation. Fix the arg matching logic.
The RouteHeaders middleware has a bug where an empty router (created with RouteHeaders() but with no routes added) invokes the next handler twice instead of once. Fix the double-invocation issue.
